summary: Flutter realtime message refresh now merges the latest page into the loaded TEXT window, preserving older messages and the current pagination cursor state. Resync-required events use the same non-destructive refresh path.

checks.name: TEXT realtime history merge regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'realtime text refresh preserves already loaded history pages'
checks.observation: After loading an older cursor page, the test added a newly committed message to the latest page and refreshed. Both the old and current messages remained, the new message appeared, and an exhausted cursor stayed null.

limitations: No Android device or ADB was available or required for these state-level checks.
Live WebSocket delivery and server-backed read-cursor behavior were not exercised.
remaining: Verify reply navigation across unloaded pages and perform a live backend realtime/read-cursor acceptance check when the environment is available.
